title: Below what extraction accuracy does an LLM-on-the-write-path memory pipeline (mem0-style) AMPLIFY stored errors via self-consistency / majority voting instead of reducing them?
why: mnemo's no-LLM-write moat, measured: self-consistency amplification with the voter = the memory extractor; falsifier: no base-accuracy threshold below which the reconciled store is worse than verbatim capture.

title: Do retrieval/association cascades in an agent memory store self-organize to criticality with power-law recall-avalanche sizes, and does value-reinforcement on recall push the store toward the critical regime?
why: Direct model of mnemo recall()+reinforcement (the measured reinforcement confound); falsifier: avalanche sizes stay exponential (no SOC) at all reinforcement rates.

title: At what optimization pressure does tuning an agent-memory system to a single recall benchmark (LOCOMO-style Goodhart proxy) make the proxy diverge from true downstream answer quality?
why: The competitor LOCOMO race, measured as goodhart-proxy with proxy = benchmark recall, target = task success; falsifier: proxy and target never decouple under optimization pressure.

title: Is there an interior optimal retrieval depth k* in memory recall — a basket size beyond which adding retrieved records degrades answers (Goodhart interior optimum in k)?
why: Maps mnemo's k hard-cap + token-pack design to the interior-K basket optimum; falsifier: answer quality is monotone nondecreasing in k.

title: Does a poisoned or echoed fact in an agent memory lock in via citation-bandwagon dynamics (each recall re-cites it) where independent re-verification would have filtered it out?
why: The echo_guard mechanism, measured as citation-bandwagon lock-in; falsifier: recall-frequency coupling does not raise false-fact survival over independent evaluation.

title: Do sequential agents writing to a shared team memory form information cascades where early wrong writes dominate later correct private signals?
why: The shared-team-memory risk model (multi-writer stores): info-cascade with writes as public actions; falsifier: cascade probability does not exceed the independent-write error rate.

title: Does a degrading agent memory store under rising conflict/supersession load show critical slowing down — rising autocorrelation and variance of recall rank — as an early warning before retrieval quality collapses?
why: An early-warning signal for memory-integrity failure: csd-earlywarning on store-health time series; falsifier: no EWS trend precedes the collapse point.

title: How much does embedding measurement error attenuate the observed correlation between memory-similarity rank and true relevance, and does correcting for attenuation change which recall recipe wins?
why: Our centering-vs-raw-cosine recall question as measurement-error attenuation; falsifier: disattenuated rankings preserve the same winner as raw rankings.

title: Do agent-memory benchmark leaderboards overstate the leader via winner's curse and selection effects, and by how much does the leader's expected true score shrink on re-measurement?
why: Competitor-audit follow-up (the inflated LOCOMO race), measured via winner's-curse + selection-FDR on leaderboard entries; falsifier: leader scores replicate within CI on fresh runs.

title: When an agent's task loop is tightly coupled to its memory layer, does memory corruption cause a first-order interdependent-cascade collapse of task success rather than graceful degradation?
why: The cost-of-integrity-failure claim: interdependent-cascade cliff with layers = (memory, task); falsifier: task success degrades smoothly with corruption fraction at realistic coupling.

title: How should a memory system's write-acceptance conservatism scale with meta-uncertainty about a source's own validity (trust seeds, provenance), and where does a trusted-only fail-closed policy sit vs the optimum?
why: The 1.19.0 trusted_only fail-closed decision, measured via meta-uncertainty conservatism with sources = memory writers; falsifier: optimal conservatism is flat in source-validity uncertainty.
